name: Aahat
description: Viewers will witness the most blood curdling horror that will keep them on the edge at all times. Horror will get ghastly, mysterious and spine chilling like never before, with the return of Aahat. This content will showcase the existence of the supernatural in the most innovative and cryptic manner. A unique amalgamation of high drama, mystery and horror, the show will entertain and haunt the viewers.

videos.title: The Closed Room
videos.overview: Seema has a massive argument with her husband in their bungalow. The husband kills her and buries her dead body in the bungalow. How will this come back to haunt him?

videos.title: Snake
videos.overview: Jai wakes up from a bad dream and shares it with his wife. He leaves for Chandangadh with his family. Will he succeed in overcoming his fear to save his life?
